items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-12-23
items.q: You've got to tell Raymond Burke. ... Don't look for Raymond Burke later, and he may have it.

ctx.x: Do they have a good tone now? Yeah, they have a good sound, yeah. Now the wood blocks you're about to die, I mean.

No, no, no, no, no, no, they're no good, no. I'm speaking about, it's a little small, a little narrow wood block, I mean. It's about that long, see. A little narrow, it's not wide like the wood blocks they've got now, see. You've got to tell Raymond Burke.
It's something that carry, you know, it's something that carry, see. Don't look for Raymond Burke later, and he may have it. Yeah, okay.
